text:
maria: Kicking off 'week zero' for SI onboarding — two-week ramp. Need alignment on training tracks, certification gates, hands-on labs, and marketplace listing checklist. Quick sync?

dan: +1. Is the plan dev-heavy or sales enablement heavy? We need both but priorities?

leo: Dev-first. Week1 = infra + runtime integration (sandbox access, sample apps). Week2 = joint PoC + co-marketing readiness.

tara: For certification, propose three tiers: Verified (self-study), Partner (instructor-led + lab pass), Premier (project-based). Pass criteria = lab score >= 80% + one live demo.

maria: I like tiers. Can we standardize the lab environment? Onboarding-bot: sandbox images are available at s3://redwood-si-labs/2026-week0.

dan: Who owns the lab exercises? Product + Eng enablement? Need a matrix of owners and time estimates.

leo: I'll own infra lab (provisioning + manifests). @tara can you own the curriculum and assessment rubrics?

tara: Yup. I'll draft rubrics. Also recommend a 90-min instructor-led workshop + 2h self-paced lab per track.

jen: For marketplace listing, legal needs SKUs and support SLA. Suggest we create a single 'SI Onboarding Pack' SKU with optional add-ons (dedicated onboarding, custom integrations).

maria: Good call. @jen can you draft a SKU proposal and pricing tiers? We'll align with finance.

dan: Ops question — how do we issue cert badges? Open Badges / Credly integration? :thinking: 

tara: Credly works. Also exportable PDF certs for resumes. We'll need a unique cert ID per partner org.

onboarding-bot: NOTE: sandbox expiry defaults to 30 days; request extensions via #eng-oncall.

leo: Timeline proposal: draft labs & rubrics by EOD Friday, alpha run with 2 SIs week after, marketplace listing draft by next Monday.

maria: Sounds good. Action items:
- leo: infra labs + manifests
- tara: rubrics + workshop slides
- jen: SKU + pricing draft
- dan: logistics + pilot SI shortlist

maria: I'll book a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. Add anything urgent here. :calendar:
